info.title: MateMágico Champions API
info.description: Identity is derived only from the Session (Authorization: Bearer). No route accepts an actor identifier. Errors: AUTH-001..005, MEM-001..005, SC-001..005 (plus USR/SCH codes).

post.summary: Register a User
Authenticate and open a Session
Revoke the current Session

get.summary: Export the authenticated user profile, memberships and attempts

post.summary: Logically deactivate the authenticated user and revoke their sessions

200.description: Metrics in Prometheus text exposition format

get.summary: List Memberships of a School with roles (requires membership:read)

post.summary: Create a Membership (requires membership:create)
Activate a Membership (canActivateMembership)
Grant a Role (canGrantRole)
Create a School; the creator becomes SCHOOL_ADMIN

get.summary: Read a School (requires school:read in it)
List topics (ACTIVE only; with schoolId and question:create, any status is allowed)

post.summary: Create a topic (requires question:create in schoolId)

patch.summary: Update or deactivate a topic (requires question:update in schoolId)

get.summary: List questions with filters (readers see PUBLISHED without the answer key; authors pass schoolId)

post.summary: Create an IMPORTED question (requires question:create in schoolId)
Import an XLSX worksheet into editorial status IMPORTED; never publishes during import

200.description: Import result; each row is CREATED, DUPLICATE, or ERROR

get.summary: List imported questions for editorial review
Editorial counts by status and duplicate imports
Read a question (published version for readers; any version for authors)

patch.summary: Update an imported or in-review question (requires question:update)

post.summary: Move an imported question to editorial review
Approve an in-review question
Reject an in-review question
Return an approved or rejected question to review
Publish only an APPROVED question (requires question:publish in schoolId)
Archive the published (or draft) version (requires question:update)
Create version N+1 as IMPORTED for editorial review; published versions are immutable

get.summary: List available published exams; requires school:read and schoolId

post.summary: Create a draft exam with deterministic question selection (exam:create)

get.summary: Get an exam in the authenticated school context

patch.summary: Edit a DRAFT exam (requires exam:create); published exams are immutable

post.summary: Publish an exam (requires exam:publish)
Archive a published exam (requires exam:publish)
Start an available published exam (school:read); does not create an Attempt
Start or idempotently resume an attempt for the authenticated learner
Submit or replace an answer in an active attempt
Finish and automatically correct an attempt
Expire an active attempt and persist its partial result

get.summary: List attempt history for the authenticated learner
School ranking (requires report:read; STUDENT is denied)
Exam ranking (requires report:read; STUDENT is denied)
Get an attempt for the authenticated learner
